The optional identity smoke-test photographs `lena.jpg` and `messi5.jpg` are from
the official OpenCV sample data repository:

- https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.x/samples/data/lena.jpg
- https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.x/samples/data/messi5.jpg

They are used only in temporary test galleries and are not copied into the
application image or enrolled into the attendance database. These tests check
actual detector/alignment/embedding matching; they do not evaluate liveness
accuracy, which requires real-camera and spoof samples.
